experiments.title: Oct structural vessel and conservative Prometheus seam
experiments.hypothesis: Oct can make the frozen source semantics executable and produce a deterministic witness without ComfyUI or Python.
experiments.inputs: source-derived constants and tiny matrices only
experiments.numerical_policy: Oct Float semantics; explicit uncentered RMSNorm; CPU fallback permitted and reported
experiments.expected_observation: frame 33, Q/K-only three-axis RoPE structure, AdaLN order, deterministic witness, and an explicit primitive route
experiments.actual_observation: three compiled semantic contracts passed; witness SHA-256 6292c9e2efbd9f89e010b345f20b9e5bfbc1b38e33a273c4005867226ce21bac; PrometheusMatMul used declared CPU fallback because Prometheus was unavailable
experiments.conclusion: Structural source semantics are executable in compiled Oct. The primitive seam is conservative CPU evidence only.
experiments.confidence: high for structural semantics; none for GPU behavior
experiments.next_question: Are any source BF16 weights unrepresentable in FP16?

source_authority: O2 validated captured-path diagnostic stage values

experiments.dimensions: reduced width 2 across all four lanes; structural proof plus selected numerical witness

experiments.expected_observation: scales use 1+x and gates use tanh in contiguous [attention scale, attention gate, MLP scale, MLP gate] order
experiments.actual_observation: compiled test passed with zero fallback; typed witness SHA-256 ef7d8580aa88205375b9d56cc4f523fc79788da3ac2e8b9027c97f93fa60d3e0. O3 also repaired interpreted signed numeric Octagon materialization and added a language corpus regression.

experiments.next_question: O4: selected real RMSNorm, QKV split/reshape, and RoPE boundary witnesses in compiled Oct

experiments.title: Pinned source tensor range census and FP16 decode audit
experiments.hypothesis: The historical W2 non-finite could be caused by source BF16-to-FP16 weight overflow.
experiments.inputs: official HTTPS byte range [11584667040,11946487712) containing the 13 BF16 tensors
experiments.numerical_policy: BF16 bits to exact Float32 semantic value, then IEEE FP16 nearest-even; no clamp or saturation
experiments.expected_observation: either source overflow explains W2 or the causal search moves to the activation path
experiments.actual_observation: all source values were finite; every tensor had zero FP16 overflow and zero saturation. W2 absmax was 1.796875. The census revealed a decoder bug that inflated normal FP16 values by 32768 in the diagnostic executor.
experiments.conclusion: Source-weight conversion overflow is rejected. The historical diagnostic W2 non-finite is confounded by a deterministic FP16 decoder defect and must be re-run with captured inputs before a storage policy is accepted.
experiments.confidence: high for source-weight ranges and decoder causality; no claim yet about correct-path activation ranges
experiments.next_question: With the pinned input and timestep, what is the first non-finite under corrected decode for BF16, FP16, and mixed policies?

experiments.title: Corrected full-path pre-attention and FFN witness replay
experiments.hypothesis: Corrected FP16 decode removes the diagnostic W2 failure, or localizes a distinct activation-path cause.
experiments.inputs: validated local OCT_EVT2_CACHE root containing layers and OCT_EVT2_ORACLE pinned revision root; captured run_02 input and timestep
experiments.numerical_policy: cached FP16 values expanded to FP32; fixed-order FP32 reductions; corrected IEEE binary16 normal exponent decode
experiments.implementation_identity: corrected canonical reference plus Oct witness orchestration
experiments.expected_observation: exact first non-finite or finite canonical stages under each policy
experiments.actual_observation: input, timestep, and cache aggregate validated. Both full diagnostic replays produced final SHA-256 4aff8bf19cfbfc9aebf2e8aa78ef91fb7bb5c117f98504080ed1bc3b206e0c43. W2 and final output are finite; the historical W2 non-finite disappears under corrected normal FP16 decode.
experiments.conclusion: The historical all-FP16 rejection is withdrawn as an inference from the defective diagnostic. It is not an accepted production policy pending Oct-led policy comparisons.
experiments.confidence: high for decoder root cause and replay determinism; medium for one full diagnostic policy
experiments.next_question: O3: generate canonical Oct pre-attention / AdaLN / RMSNorm witnesses and compare source BF16 versus cached FP16 at those boundaries

experiments.dimensions: one complete W2 reduction, 10240 multiply-accumulate terms
experiments.numerical_policy: compiled Oct Float fixed left-to-right dot; conservative Go FP32 product and partial-sum scan; 1e-3 Oct-vs-FP32 tolerance
experiments.expected_observation: no non-finite product or partial sum; fixed-order output agrees with captured W2
experiments.actual_observation: first non-finite index -1; product range [-748.3084,409.52567]; partial-sum range [-4047.3066,549.47736]; fixed-order and captured FP32 output -4012.8704; Oct witness SHA-256 d91a9076956b5aeaeb1e69a00ea351939b911501f75d1e9515199d01d3bf469d

experiments.title: Source BF16 versus cached FP16 complete W2 reduction comparison
experiments.hypothesis: The W2 source row and transformed cache column represent the same numerical weights, so their selected complete dot products agree.
experiments.inputs: W2 output-channel-zero source BF16 row, transformed FP16 cache column, and complete 10240-term gated-hidden row
experiments.numerical_policy: original BF16 and cached FP16 expanded to FP32; fixed left-to-right order
experiments.expected_observation: source/cache weight and output differences either localize FP16 conversion loss or remain zero
experiments.actual_observation: 10240/10240 weights exact; maximum weight delta 0; BF16 and FP16 fixed-order FP32 outputs both -4012.8704; output delta 0
experiments.conclusion: W2 source BF16 conversion is excluded as a cause of the historical failure; W2 is an FP16-safe weight-storage candidate.
experiments.confidence: high for source/cache equivalence and selected full dot
